proposal.justification: The investigation shows unexplained energy loss with candidate causes METER_FAULT and UNMETERED_LOAD. The RESIDUAL values from workers W1 and W2 exceed the threshold, while W3 indicates insufficient meter billing data. The most informative, low-cost check is a targeted meter review that can confirm meter health and detect possible unauthorized/unmetered loads without requiring full topology mapping or extensive data gathering.
